character.name: Jsonstrophe

traits.title: Tablets from 64% JSON
traits.description: Most of its files are JSON, so a swarm of little data tablets, each labelled by file type, orbits it.

traits.title: Parts stacked in data/mods
traits.description: Nearly half its files sit in one mods folder, so it is a golem stitched together from thousands of small parts.

traits.title: Chained by game.h includes
traits.description: game.h pulls in array, chrono, cstdint, ctime and functional, so its arms are bound by a chain of headers.

character.originStory: WANTED: Jsonstrophe. Known for surviving a turn-based post-apocalypse while juggling 64 percent JSON. Last seen lurking in data/mods/, where 4,748 files crowd the shelves. Its only pyproject.toml exists to keep lines at 79 characters, a habit it considers a personal challenge. Dangerous when someone opens game.h, since its includes never end. Reward: one full tank of gas, offered to whoever convinces it that a semicolon is enough.
